description: Start background regeneration; poll get_asset_flow_task. Asset sets reuse stored images unless forceFreshProvider=true with an exact itemId in live mode (paid, needs user approval). Legacy output targets re-run their paid producer. Pass a new idempotencyKey to buy another image. Use get_flow_outputs to read results.

forceFreshProvider.description: Buy a new image for this asset-set item. Requires itemId, live mode, user approval, and the configured spend ceiling. Defaults to reusing stored images.

idempotencyKey.description: Omit for live regenerations to reuse a key that stays the same for 10 minutes for this node and item, so a repeat in that window buys no new image. Pass a new key to buy another; reuse a key when retrying the same dispatch.

itemId.description: Exact asset-set manifest item for a fresh provider retry. Requires forceFreshProvider=true and live mode. Omit for local processing of the whole set.

mode.description: mock = free dry run. live = paid provider generation — confirm with the user first.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

targetNodeId.description: Node to rerun from. For a paid asset-set item retry, choose a completed processor node owning that item’s artifact (e.g. remove-background). Omit itemId for local processing of the whole set. Legacy output nodes resolve to paid generation. Use get_flow_outputs to fetch results.

name: start_regenerate_asset_flow_node
